svg.title: 1929 · Cotton spinning capacity
svg.desc: Circle area shows active-producing cotton spindles. Equipment counts are not cloth output.
svg.text: Circle area shows active-producing cotton spindles. Equipment counts are not cloth output.
Observed: 1929 · Constant circle-area scale across all four dates.
Source: BLS Bulletin 898, table 3, printed p.9 / PDF p.15. New England is a regional total, not a state estimate.
Southeast = AL FL GA KY MS NC SC TN VA. Florida is not listed separately; missing is never zero.
1929: listed states sum to 17,843,861; printed Southeast total is 17,843,852. Both retained. 1899 coverage differs.
